1.
Heard Sri Vipin Chandra, Advocate, holding brief of Sri Vindesh Kumar, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rajeev Kumar Singh, learned AGA for the State.

2. The present application has been filed to quash the chargesheet dated 23.12.2019 along with impugned cognizance order dated 01.11.2021 as well as entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1023 of 2021, under Sections-498A, 323 IPC & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Sadar Bazar, District-Shahjahanpur, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate Ist, Shahjahanpur, arising out of case crime no.0436 of 2019.

3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that dispute between the parties is matrimonial in nature and now they have settled their dispute amicably and a compromise has also been entered into between them.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection that aforesaid compromise is yet to be verified by the court below, therefore, applicants may be directed to file aforesaid compromise before the court below for verification.
5. Considering the aforesaid submission, present application is disposed of with a direction to the applicants to file original deed of compromise before the court below, within a period of 15 days.

In case, such compromise is filed before the court below, the court below will verify the same after summoning the parties within a period of two months from the date of receiving the copy of compromise.
6. After verification of the compromise, court below will dispose of the impugned proceeding, in accordance with law.
7. It is further provided that for a period of two and a half months or till the verification of compromise, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.
8. It is further provided that applicants are at liberty to file fresh application u/s 528 of BNSS, to quash the impugned proceeding on the basis of verified compromise.
